content:
In addition to the Best Buy 60th anniversary sale, this week's deals including 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off all five colours of AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 at a historic low price are still ongoing, but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also has some new deals worth noting. If you act fast, the official Apple Refurbished Store has just been restocked, with the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down to $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue, and we've also spotted multiple configurations of the new M5 Pro MacBook Pro with $400 off. The $100 off Apple Watch Series 11 deal is also back, starting from just over $250, and we also have deals on Twelve South accessories — including new low prices on its Find My charger and Curve Nano MagSafe stand at Amazon. All deals are listed below.

AirPods deals drop again, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After a summer of solid deals on Apple's newest AirPods lineup, prices have dropped even further on virtually every model. The coveted AirPods Pro 3 is now 25% off at one of its lowest prices ever, the ANC-equipped AirPods 4 has dropped to its lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 took another $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (was $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (was $129)

AirTag 2 back at historic low price, from $22 each (4-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Excellent" open-box $20 (was $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (was $99)

Best Buy one-day anniversary LG deals: TVs from $330, 2026 OLED models $600 off, more

Restock alert: Most affordable M5 MacBook Air for $1,099 via Apple Refurbished, act fast ($200 off new)

Update 8/20: This deal has now been restocked at the $1,099 price in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This deal will likely sell out fast — it always does — but the official Apple Refurbished Store has just restocked the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro for $1,099 with free shipping, in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This configuration sells out fast every time Apple restocks it, so if you're interested, don't miss out — after all, this is the lowest price for the M5 MacBook Air.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,099 with free shipping. As mentioned above, as of writing, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue are available.

This machine is originally priced at $1,299, now $200 off the new price.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (was $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

FYI, all products at the official Apple Refurbished Store come with the following coverage:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Sold after Apple's rigorous refurbishment process

For comparison, the same configuration brand new on Amazon is priced very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver model down to $1,240.

Amazon still has solid $400 off deals on select M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations

As part of its 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy held a special one-day Apple promotion yesterday. The highlight was $400 off two configurations of the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but if you missed it, Amazon still has these two deals today.

Amazon is still selling these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models for $400 below MSRP — one with base CPU/GPU specs and one upgraded to an 18-core CPU and 12-core config.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (was $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (was $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we featured yesterday, but at the time it looked like they'd only last a day — Best Buy did say so, and there was no way to know if Amazon would follow suit. Overall, Amazon could pull these deals at any time, but as of writing they're still live, and we wanted to make sure you didn't miss them.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM and 1TB of storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This configuration, originally $3,099, is $400 less than buying direct from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary deal $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour 60th anniversary Apple promotion has ended, there are still plenty of great deals to be had. In addition to 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the return of Apple AirTag 2 at a historic low price, we've also spotted $100 off all the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models at Amazon and Best Buy — and you can even find "Excellent" open-box models for as low as $254.

Amazon is once again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models for $329 with free shipping. That's $100 off the $429 MSRP, and all four case colours are eligible for this discounted price.

However, their smaller and more affordable 42mm versions are now almost completely out of stock. That's where Best Buy comes in.

They're in the middle of a week-long 60th anniversary sale, and all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models are in stock and selling for $100 off MSRP.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (was $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (was $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I also wanted to mention the "Excellent" open-box deal on the Jet Black 42mm model — you can get one for $253.99 with free shipping, which is $145 off the brand-new MSRP. Compared to buying a brand-new unit now, that's only $45 less, but $45 isn't a small amount, and it's the lowest price we can find at a reputable retailer.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models are $220 off today (matching Prime Day deals)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (was $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can get a fully functional iPhone 16 starting from $699 with a one-year Apple warranty; while the 1TB 16 Pro Max is $1,269 — that's $330 less than a comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than a 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)

The Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the nicest MagSafe stands I've ever seen, $27 (was $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South's versatile woven PowerCord USB-C charger is now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for just $180? Rare deal drops WD Elements portable hard drive to lowest price since storage price hikes (today only)
  • Woot's latest deals: Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime dock is $100 off, a new low price
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theatre with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit for immersive reactive lighting, from $110, with more models from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 offers 360-degree pet monitoring and two-way talk for $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite with Matter, from $85, or other models up to 47% off, from $80
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable, $36 today

Amazon now has $120 off all five colours of AirPods Max 2 (one of the best prices ever)

This week's 60th anniversary sale has brought one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, and Amazon now has $120 off all five colours.

Amazon is now selling Apple's AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Like the previous generation, it's priced at $549, which means you save $120, and it's the lowest price for a brand-new unit we can find at a reputable retailer right now.

Best Buy does have a Midnight Black set in "Excellent" open-box condition for $403.99 with free shipping, which is even cheaper, but it may not be cheap enough to give up on a brand-new unit.

Apple has launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, rather than just a new colour and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear models won't be updated at next month's new product launch, so this week we can pick up what will likely be Apple's most up-to-date and powerful over-ear headphones for a while at $120 off.

There was only one previous promotion that sold for less than this — this summer's Prime Day, when prices were $30 lower than today's deal price, and stock during the 4-day promotion was quite limited and volatile.

The Anker 45W Nano smart display charger is still at its $26 low price, but this bundle adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more

As part of its ongoing 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy is selling the white Anker 45W Nano smart display charger for $29.99 with free shipping, and includes a Nano USB-C cable. That's about $4 more than the charger's current $25.99 free-shipping discounted price, which is still available at both Amazon and Best Buy. Considering that the included Nano USB-C cable normally sells for around $18, you're essentially paying just $4 to add the cable, which is a great deal. See below for more details.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN Smart Display Charger $25.99 (was $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

Anker's 45W Nano charger features a built-in smart display that can identify supported devices (such as iPhone and iPad Pro models) and automatically adjust power delivery. The screen also shows real-time charging information and animations, so you can see the charging status instantly when your device is plugged in. It features a top-mounted USB-C port that delivers up to 45W output, plus foldable prongs that fold 180 degrees, making it easy to carry whether for everyday use or on the go. Anker offers it in four colours, including an orange that pairs perfectly with Apple's Cosmic Orange devices. This special deal includes Anker's Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. This woven cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it a solid choice overall, and a great value if you want a new reliable cable to charge your phone.

Other notable Anker deals

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (was $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (was $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (was $150)
